statements.status_notes: Upstream fixed the crafted HEVC bitstream heap write in libde265 1.0.17, but Debian trixie's 1.0.15-1+deb13u1 package remains vulnerable. Waiting for a fixed Debian 13 package.
Upstream fixed the malformed H.265 PPS NAL unit crash in libde265 1.0.17, but Debian trixie's 1.0.15-1+deb13u1 package remains vulnerable. Waiting for a fixed Debian 13 package.

libde265 (HEVC decoder) is pulled in via gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad, part of the WebKit media dependency set that upstream Playwright's install-deps mandates for Debian 13. No fixed version is available in Debian trixie. Whether Playwright-driven WebKit sessions can reach the HEVC decode paths with untrusted input is under investigation.
